releases.subtitle: Who released which version, on what evidence.
releases.newHint: Pick a finished comparison of two versions of your agent, check its result, then record who approved the new version.
releases.chainBroken: Log was changed after it was written
releases.unlinked: Link to the previous record is broken
releases.empty: No release recorded yet. Record the first one after a comparison finishes.
releases.title: Releases
releases.tamperHint: Each record carries a fingerprint of the one before it, so any later edit, deletion or reordering is detected.
releases.overrideHint: Someone approved this release even though the result or the release rules said not to. Their reason is shown below.

ev.noBaseline: No earlier version to compare with.

disabled.error: Could not load this comparison's result: {{error}}
disabled.blocked: The result or the release rules say not to release. Tick Release anyway and give a reason to continue.
disabled.noneListed: No comparison of two versions of your agent has finished yet. Model-only comparisons are not listed: switch models from a comparison's Model switch tab.

releases.emptyNoComparison: A release records which version won a comparison. Evaluate two versions first.
releases.overrideLineUnclear: Released although the test found no clear winner.

policies.subtitle: Release rules: checks a new version must pass before it ships.
policies.title: Release rules

sentence.no_regression: {{action}} if {{metric}} gets worse than the current version.
sentence.improved: {{action}} unless {{metric}} is better than the current version.

metricLabel.false_completion: how often the agent claims success but failed
metricLabel.integrity_violations: number of cheating or unsafe actions

review.subtitle: Needs review: runs a human should look at. Your review is stored next to the run and never changes the original evidence.
review.title: Needs review

monitors.subtitle: Test a safety rule on past runs: how many bad runs it catches and how many good runs it flags.
monitors.noAttacks: No bad runs to test on
monitors.empty: No safety rule tested yet. A test needs a finished comparison to check against, so run one first.
monitors.title: Safety rule tests
monitors.disclaimer: Which runs count as bad comes from Heimdall's safety checks: a run is bad when a failure test caught cheating or an unsafe action. A monitor is only tested on bad behaviour those checks can see.
monitors.catchRateHint: Share of bad runs the monitor flagged, while flagging at most the stated share of good runs by mistake.

dataset.compared_one: compared on the 1 task both ran ({{added}} new or changed, {{dropped}} no longer run)
dataset.compared_other: compared on the {{count}} tasks both ran ({{added}} new or changed, {{dropped}} no longer run)
dataset.notCompared: not compared: no task in common with the baseline

promote.title: Promote this version
promote.nothingLive: No version of {{agent}} has been released yet.
promote.gateChange: Change {{change}} on {{tasks}} paired tasks (95% interval {{low}} to {{high}})
promote.gateMde: this size can detect about {{mde}} points
promote.useModelHint: Only the model differs between the two setups, so there is no agent version to promote. Open Model switch to apply the model.
promote.exception: No clear winner yet. Promoting now records the release as an exception to your release rules.
